This appears to be a memos repository.

Searching the backend Go code for the SignIn RPC handler. It likely resides in the auth service.

The proto defines SignIn as an RPC on AuthService.

Searching the server directory for the Go implementation.

Two candidates were identified for the SignIn RPC handler. The first candidate is APIV1Service.

The second candidate is `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`. This appears to be a connect-rpc adapter wrapping the actual implementation. Both files will be checked to confirm which one truly handles the SignIn RPC.
